commit.message:
fix(sed): anchor $ and ^ at the edges of a BRE alternative

breToEre in src/commands/sed/sed-regex.ts turned \| into
| but treated $ as an anchor only at the end of the pattern or before \),
and ^ only at the start or after \(. So b$\|^c became b\$|\^c, and
printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed -n '/b$\|^c/p' printed nothing where GNU sed
prints ab and cd. The GNU sed manual (BRE syntax) defines ^ as special
after \( or \| and $ as special before \) or \|. Address patterns and
BRE s patterns both go through breToEre, so both were wrong.

I now track whether the previous token was \| so ^ anchors at the start
of the next alternative, and I treat $ as an anchor when \| follows it.
A $ or ^ in the middle of an alternative stays literal, and -E s patterns
don't go through breToEre at all. I added
sed.bre-alternation-anchor.test.ts with 4 cases and a patch changeset.

Focused test with sed-regex.ts from main, then on this branch.

    pnpm exec vitest run src/commands/sed/sed.bre-alternation-anchor.test.ts
     x anchors $ before \|
     x anchors ^ after \|
     x anchors both edges in an s command
    AssertionError: expected '' to be 'ab\n'
    AssertionError: expected '' to be 'cd\n'
    AssertionError: expected 'ab\ncd\n' to be 'aX\nXd\n'
          Tests  3 failed | 1 passed (4)

    pnpm exec vitest run src/commands/sed/sed.bre-alternation-anchor.test.ts
          Tests  4 passed (4)

End to end with new Bash().exec() through tsx, main then this branch.
The branch output also matches dist/bundle/index.js after pnpm build.

                                                   main          branch
    printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed -n '/b$\|^c/p'         ""            "ab\ncd\n"
    printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed 's/b$\|^c/X/'          "ab\ncd\n"    "aX\nXd\n"
    printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed -n '/xx\|^c/p'         ""            "cd\n"
    printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed -n '/b$\|xx/p'         ""            "ab\n"
    printf 'a$b\nc^d\n' | sed -n '/a$b\|c^d/p'     "a$b\nc^d\n"  "a$b\nc^d\n"
    printf 'ab\ncd\n' | sed -n '/\(b$\|^c\)/p'     ""            "ab\ncd\n"

vendor/cpython-emscripten, which holds the Git LFS python.wasm, and the
same 6 fail with sed-regex.ts from main. No sed test fails.
